reasons: Deliverable A shows a clean, continuous left-to-right activation sequence with smoothly curving isochrones and an APD80 map that varies slowly (≈520 ms basal-left to ≈475 ms apical-right, roughness 0.30 ms, outliers 0.02%), consistent with a single propagating wavefront and physiological repolarisation gradient. Deliverable B's APD80 map contains clear processing artefacts: a sharp near-horizontal dark streak (~470 ms) cutting across the lower-right tissue, dark blotchy rims along the left and right borders, and a mottled texture, reflected in a 4x higher roughness (1.25 ms) and 35x higher outlier fraction (0.7%). B's larger, ragged mask with protrusions and a flat bottom cut extends into low-signal edge regions where both maps degrade, whereas A's mask, although smoothly rounded and likely somewhat conservative, confines analysis to tissue where the maps are reliable. B's activation map is acceptable and even shows a plausible late-activation region upper right, but its isochrones near the left and lower edges are more irregular than A's. For downstream conduction-velocity and repolarisation-heterogeneity analysis, A's maps would be trusted more.
